case.pattern: Card-not-present fraud from a new device

evidence.claim: Card C13487-K1 shows regular in-person transactions and occasional online purchases (e.g., txn 3478561 for $74.96 on 2016-11-22 and txn 3489320 for $252.28 on 2016-11-26). The analyst notes that several cards this month exhibit purchases from the same unusual device profile. Local and global historical lookups yielded no matching prior closed cases.

case.summary: Card C13487-K1 shows regular in-person transactions and occasional online purchases (e.g., txn 3478561 for $74.96 on 2016-11-22 and txn 3489320 for $252.28 on 2016-11-26). The analyst notes that several cards this month exhibit purchases from the same unusual device profile. Local and global historical lookups yielded no matching prior closed cases.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer states they did not make these purchases and still has the card.

initial.reason: Moderate fraud probability with a new device profile for online transactions warrants step-up authentication before blocking.

final.reason: Customer confirmed they did not make the purchases and still has the card, indicating card compromise via an unusual device profile.

next_best_actions.what_changed: Customer validation confirmed unauthorized activity and physical card possession, escalating the response from step-up authentication to card blocking.

sar.reason: No structured SAR decision was requested.
